messages:
Maya: FYI, seeing a wear-wave in us-west1 local SSD fleet starting ~10:50 UTC, IOPS tail latency up ~4x and node attach latency spiking. GPU attach rate dropped ~30% in the last 8m.
Eli: can you paste the top log lines / metrics?
Maya: log snippets: 
```
ERROR attach: timeout waiting for disk ready (dev nvme0n1)\nnvme: write retries=12, queue_depth=128\njanitor: scrub-rate=high, active_jobs=480\n```
Maya: looks like janitor/scrub concurrency ramped and we now have a backlog; drives heating up per telemetry.
infra-bot: Incident created: INC-2026-4513 (local-ssd wear-wave, us-west1) — page oncall.
Chris: oncall here. Confirming increased SMART reassign counts + thermal events on 6 racks. GPU pods queued waiting for ephemeral.
Sam: Any quick mitigation? Can we throttle scrubs on affected AZs?
Eli: We can patch janitor concurrency config — set per-node concurrency cap from 8 -> 2; reduces immediate IOPS. Will push canary to us-west1-azc.
Tina: +1 to throttling, also can we increase overprovisioning on that pool to avoid attach rejects?
Ops-SRE: Queueing a quick feature flag: `janitor.max_concurrency_per_node=2` and `scratchpool.overprovision=0.12` for us-west1. Rolling now.
Chris: Also toggle GPU scheduler fallback to prefer cached nodes until scrub backlog clears.
Maya: Deploy looks good in canary, attach latency halved in canary hosts after 90s.
Eli: Rolling flag to remaining AZs in us-west1, estimated 3m.
Sam: What's long-term follow-up?
Tina: We should: 1) tighten scrub scheduling to off-peak windows, 2) implement thermal-aware scrub pacing, 3) surface per-node scrub pressure in console, 4) add auto-fallback routing for GPU attaches.
Maya: Filing follow-up RFC for thermal-aware janitor and scrub pacer. I'll add telemetry dashboards and alert thresholds so we get earlier warning.
infra-bot: Update INC-2026-4513: mitigation applied, monitoring for regressions.
Chris: Marking incident as mitigated for now. We'll leave throttles for 1h then evaluate.
Sam: thanks all — please post postmortem notes and action items once RFC drafted. :thumbsup:
Maya: will do.
Eli: logging the exact command we ran for auditing: 
```
curl -XPOST $OPSFLAGSET_URL/flags -d '{"key":"janitor.max_concurrency_per_node","val":2,"scope":"us-west1"}'
curl -XPOST $OPSFLAGSET_URL/flags -d '{"key":"scratchpool.overprovision","val":0.12,"scope":"us-west1"}'
```
Chris: noted. closing thread when RFC linked.
